source.note: Search summary of skiresort.info, Powderhounds and OnTheSnow: 215 km of slopes; about 140 marked runs = 24 green, 55 blue, 41 red, 19 black (139); 75 lifts including 6 gondolas and 28 chairlifts (the other 41, surface lifts and carpets, not broken down); hourly capacity about 100,700 skiers.

Piste reference data — confirm at source. Only features Piste is confident about are set; everything else is unknown (null), not 'not offered'. Ski schools and rental shops operate in the resort villages

character: Grandvalira is Andorra's largest ski area, linking Pas de la Casa, Grau Roig, Soldeu, El Tarter, Canillo and Encamp across about 215 km of pistes between roughly 1,710 m and 2,640 m. It is the main area of the Grandvalira Resorts group, which is on the Ikon Pass.
learning: Grandvalira has 24 green and 55 blue runs (search summary). Reference: large beginner areas exist at several bases; confirm lesson and beginner-pass options for 2026-27.

announcedOpening.text: Opening of the 2026/2027 season scheduled for 4 Dec 2026, weather permitting (per search summary of Grandvalira's opening/closing FAQ and esquiades.com).

announcedClosing.text: Planned closing 4 Apr 2027, depending on weather and snow (per search summary).

season.typicalText: Usually early December to early/mid-April (reference; 2026-27: 4 Dec to 4 Apr).

prices.note: Search summary: 2026/27 adult 18–64 €72; junior 12–17 €61; child 6–11 €47. Official prices may vary by date — confirm on grandvalira.com.
